item.title: [Project Syndicate] 美国国会如何回应民众诉求
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

美国普通家庭正在为特朗普总统的关税政策和伊朗战争买单——通过更高的物价和借贷成本。国会完全有能力制止这一切：收回关税政策制定权和对军事行动的主导权，并要求对未来战争的开支进行公开核算。

英文原文（Original）

American households are footing the bill for President Donald Trump’s tariffs and war in Iran through higher prices and borrowing costs. Congress has the power to stop this by reclaiming its authority over tariff policy and the use of military force, and by requiring a public accounting of the costs of future wars.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] 反抗寡头：亿万富翁的权力威胁与民众觉醒
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

如今亿万富翁掌握的惊人权力，对民主和地球都构成了威胁。令人鼓舞的是，世界各地的人们因生活负担不起、就业前景恶化而感到沮丧，正开始发现他们能够掌握多大的政治权力。

英文原文（Original）

The extraordinary power wielded by today’s billionaires is a threat to democracy and the planet. Encouragingly, people around the world, frustrated by a lack of affordability and worsening job prospects, are beginning to discover just how much political power they can wield.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] 谁能在对俄和谈中代表欧洲？
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

欧盟在谈判中找不到一个能代表它的人，这反映的是结构性失败，而不是缺人才。正因如此，欧盟应当让位，把特使人选的决定权交给英国、法国和德国。

英文原文（Original）

The European Union's inability to find one person to represent it in such negotiations reflects a structural failure, not a shortage of skilled personnel. That is why the EU should step aside and delegate the selection of an envoy to the United Kingdom, France, and Germany.

item.title: [Project Syndicate] 化石燃料终局无需COP共识
item.description:
Project Syndicate · 查看网页原文 ↗

经济学家观点精翻

尽管今年的联合国气候谈判未能取得成果，但毫无疑问，逐步淘汰化石燃料是正确的目标。唯一的问题是，一个“意愿联盟”能否运用政策手段，推动市场以比传统COP进程更快、更公平、更平稳的方式完成转型。

英文原文（Original）

Despite the failure of this year's United Nations climate talks, there is no doubt that phasing out fossil fuels is the right goal. The only question is whether a coalition of the willing can use policy to push markets toward a faster, fairer, and smoother transition than the traditional COP process can deliver.
